privacy.visibilityDesc: Who fit open your full profile — your activity, your climb and your stats. Public: anybody wey dey Shape. Only friends: na only members wey una dey share chat. Private: e go hide, so people go just see your name and your tier.

privacy.onlineDesc: When e on, one live dot go show for your avatar so people go sabi say you dey active for the app now. Off am make you fit browse quiet-quiet — dem no go ever show say you dey around.
privacy.shareWorkoutDesc: When e on, the workout wey you log, your PRs and your activity fit show for your profile and for the community feed. Off go make your training show only for you and the coach wey you connect.
privacy.agePublic: Show my age for my profile
privacy.agePublicDesc: E dey off by default. If you put am on, na your age — no be the day wey you born — go show for your profile. Your coach dem go always see the age of the clients wey dem dey work with, because e dey change how dem dey plan for you.

integrations.intro: Connect health, activity, and music platforms. Workout wey WHOOP import dey private first, den you go choose wetin coaches or di community feed go see.
integrations.loadError: We no fit load di integrations.
integrations.noteAppleHealthNative: Read your steps, heart rate, HRV, resting HR, sleep, active energy, and workouts from Apple Health (Apple Watch too) go inside your daily snapshot.
integrations.noteAppleHealthWeb: Apple Health (and Apple Watch) data dey only for di Shape iOS app. Open Shape for your iPhone make you connect am.
integrations.noteAppleMusic: Authorize Apple Music with MusicKit make your library fit give you workout playlist. Na here you dey give di access — no redirect.
integrations.noteGarmin: Pull Garmin Connect activities, heart rate, and sleep enter your profile. E need Garmin Health API approval for di developer account.
integrations.noteInstacart: Send di grocery list wey your coach build go Instacart make e open cart wey don full already. While Instacart access still dey wait, we go copy di list go your clipboard instead.
integrations.noteOura: Sync Oura Ring sleep, readiness, and heart-rate data enter your daily health snapshot. Workouts dey import private, like WHOOP.
integrations.noteSpotify: Pick workout playlist from your Spotify library make you attach am to program. E dey stream for Shape Radio and for di workout player.
integrations.noteStrava: Connect Strava activities and map data. Route import go use di same private-first sharing style like WHOOP.
integrations.noteWhoop: Sync recovery, sleep, body measurements, cycles, and workouts. Workout wey you import dey private until you share am.
integrations.reconcileMeta: When two device no gree — pick which one to trust
aboutPage.letter.p1: Shape na exactly wetin di name dey talk — to shape your life make e be wetin you want. Your routine, your sleep, wetin you dey cook, di music wey dey move you, how you dey talk to yourself for hard days, di people wey you dey spend Saturday with. Na why we build Shape: make e be di place wey you fit work on all of am, for your own terms.
aboutPage.heroLead: Your trainer don already plan di next few weeks. Your nutritionist plan don turn to grocery list before you even talk am. Wen you open di workout card, music go start — na your coach pick am for dat session. Shape Score dey watch everything. If you miss one day, e know. If you build streak, e go show am. Di community no be moderated sweet talk — na people wey dey for middle of di same road, dey figure am out as e dey happen. Nobody here don finish. Na dat one be di point.
aboutPage.idea.h1Pre: Di platform wey coaches dey build dem
aboutPage.idea.coachHead: Your business and your people — one house.
aboutPage.idea.coachBody: Run your whole practice — clients, programs, payment — and build your following for di social platform wey dem make for coaching, training and nutrition. Your content, your clients, your money, for one place: no be five apps and di wrong crowd. Here, everybody don dey train already — so na di correct audience you get. Na here dem dey build coaching business, and na here people dey see am.
aboutPage.idea.memberHead: Training life wey really get people inside.
aboutPage.idea.memberBody: Real coaches, plans wey na your own, and people wey dey train near you wey dey for middle of di road too. No be highlight reel — na di day-to-day of getting better, wey you dey share with di people wey dey your corner. Di coach go start you; di community go keep you here.
aboutPage.idea.closerPre: Coaches dey bring di people. Di people dey build di place.
aboutPage.idea.closerAccent: Na di whole idea be dat.
aboutPage.letter.h1Post: na di door wey you take enter.
aboutPage.letter.p2: E dey start with coach. To get better one no suppose be luxury. Plenty apps dey use chatbot replace dem; plenty gym dey hide di good ones behind package. We feel say better way dey: open di door for trainers, nutritionists and registered dietitians wey really care, den make dat level of guidance reach di rest of us.
aboutPage.letter.p3: Shape dey build di loop round all of am. Your trainer go program your week before you even reach — every set, every tempo, every cue don load since night before, so you no go stand for front of di rack dey wonder wetin dey next. Your nutritionist go build meal plan round your own goals — whether na to hit macro target, manage food wey you no fit chop, build round health condition, or just chop better — and dat plan go turn to grocery list wey you fit really shop with.
aboutPage.letter.p4: As you dey show up — day after day, workout after workout, habit after habit — your Shape Score dey rise with you. E dey track how you dey consistent, e dey reward your effort, and e dey show di standing wey you really work for.
aboutPage.letter.p5: Place dey too wey you fit write down wetin you dey shape towards — strength, sleep, calm, confidence, marathon, one particular body goal, abi just to feel like yourself again. Structure wen you need am. Discipline wey you build, no be something wey dem hand you.
aboutPage.letter.p6Pre: Den di part wey no app don ever get right:
aboutPage.letter.p6Post: . You fit keep your journey private — or share am. Wetin you cook, wetin your nutritionist recommend dis week, wetin you lift, wetin your coach talk. Tips, recipes, nutrition advice, coaches and dietitians wey worth to try. Whole feed of people wey dey figure out di same things wey you dey figure out.
aboutPage.letter.pull2: Di community no be forum. Na di people wey dey inside your loop.
aboutPage.letter.p7: Shape na di place wey you go find di coach, build di habits, earn your score, hear di music, and meet di people. Di rest na just to show up.
aboutPage.founderAlt: Chris Perry, di person wey start Shape
aboutPage.founderBio: Chris spend ten years for finance — dey build relationship, dey help business grow, and e sabi say one day e go build and run him own. Athlete since e small, with marathons and one Ironman for him back, e turn dat drive go wetin e really like: health and fitness. Dem build Shape on one simple belief — good coaching no suppose be luxury or too costly, and e no suppose mean say you go dey do am alone. Na di best platform wey e fit make for personal coaching and to share di journey: true community, wey dem build to help you shape your life di way you want am.
